title: Switching graphs and designs
summary: Switching methods can be seen as certain local transformations that do not alter their basic parameters of a combinatorial structure. Efforts have been devoted in the literature to relate and unify the switching theories for codes and designs, and also for Hadamard matrices and graphs. The combinatorial structures we consider in this paper are graphs and designs. We show an extension of known switching method for constructing 2-designs to divisible designs, and then provide some examples of its application.
